name: DatePicker
summary: Pick a date or a date range from a calendar — schedules, deadlines, filters — rendered through the shared DatePicker.
lead: DatePicker carries a calendar panel, ranges, presets and locale handling — too much to rebuild as a web component, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both themed once by the shared datepickerTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

whenToUse.when: a single date — a deadline, a start date
a start and end together — a reporting window, a schedule
a free-form date the user already knows precisely — but prefer the picker for validity

opinion.note: Pre-fill a sensible default (today, or the current period) rather than empty. Constrain impossible dates with disabledDate instead of validating after the fact. Dates use Day.js.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared datepickerTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme (datepickerTheme); residual drift is caught by visual regression. Both use Day.js for dates.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the measure reads the real antd v6 picker field bound to datepickerTheme.
